procedural_issues_en: The itemized statement was received 3 days after the computed August 21, 2027 deadline, although the forwarding address was provided on July 31. Connecticut law provides for double damages for a violation of the return/itemization deadline; the computed double-damages figure is $8,600. Consider asking a Connecticut tenant-rights group or lawyer to confirm how this applies to the claim.

The statement lists a refund of $3,017.60 but does not include the computed accrued interest of $21.01. Because the statement is also late, ask that the interest be paid and have a local tenant-rights group or lawyer confirm the applicable remedy.

The lease says the deposit is held in escrow, but the supplied record does not establish whether the landlord gave the required written notice naming the amount held and the financial institution within 30 days. Check for that notice.
The deposit of $4,300 does not exceed the supplied cap of $4,300.

명세서에는 3,017.60달러 환급만 기재되어 있고 계산된 이자 21.01달러는 포함되어 있지 않습니다. 명세서도 늦었으므로 이자 지급을 요청하고, 구체적인 구제 방법은 지역 임차인 지원단체나 변호사에게 확인하세요.
계약서에는 보증금을 에스크로 계좌에 보관한다고 되어 있지만, 제공된 자료만으로는 집주인이 30일 내 보관액과 금융기관 이름을 적은 서면 통지를 했는지 확인되지 않습니다. 해당 통지를 확인하세요.

ruling.ruling_en: Approved deductions total $287.40: $150 for carpet cleaning, $62.40 for the final water/sewer bill, and $75 for rekeying; the other three charges are not supported on this record. With $21.01 accrued interest, the requested refund is $4,033.61. The itemized statement arrived three days after the stated deadline despite the forwarding address being provided on July 31, 2027; CT-47a-21-d2 provides for potential double damages, but a Connecticut tenant-rights group or lawyer should confirm the remedy. Also request the escrow notice and confirmation of the actual rekeying cost if disputed.
ruling.ruling_ko: 인정되는 공제액은 총 287.40달러입니다. 카펫 청소 150달러, 최종 수도·하수도 요금 62.40달러, 재키 비용 75달러이며 나머지 세 항목은 현재 자료로 뒷받침되지 않습니다. 이자 21.01달러를 더하면 요청할 환급액은 4,033.61달러입니다. 주소를 2027년 7월 31일 제공했지만 명세서는 기한보다 3일 늦게 도착했습니다. CT-47a-21-d2에 따라 보증금 두 배 배상 가능성이 있으나, 구체적인 적용은 코네티컷 임차인 지원단체나 변호사에게 확인하는 것이 좋습니다. 에스크로 통지서와, 다툼이 있는 경우 실제 재키 비용도 요청하세요.
ruling.letter_en:
[DATE]

Dear Landlord,

I am writing about the security-deposit accounting for my tenancy, which ended July 31, 2027. I provided my forwarding address on July 31, 2027, and received the itemized statement on August 24, 2027, three days after the stated August 21 deadline.

I dispute the $480 charge for Living room floor plank replacement. Exhibit E2, move-in condition evidence (date to be confirmed), and Exhibit E12, move-out evidence, July 31, 2027, show the same gouge. I also dispute the $165 charge for Hallway wall patch and repaint near light switch: Exhibit E4, move-in condition evidence (date to be confirmed), and Exhibit E14, move-out evidence, July 31, 2027, show the same chip. The $350 charge for Bedroom wall crack repair and repaint is not established by the current record; Exhibit E20, move-out evidence, July 31, 2027, does not establish when the crack arose or who caused it. These items are not supported as tenant-caused damages under the lease, p. 3, or CT-47a-21-a14 and CT-47a-11. Please provide the dated inspection record or other evidence supporting the bedroom-wall charge if you maintain it.

I accept $150 for Professional carpet cleaning under the lease, p. 3, and $62.40 for Final water/sewer bill (Conservice) under the lease, p. 2. I also accept $75 for Rekeying - unreturned key under the lease, p. 1, subject to confirmation that it is the actual reasonable cost of changing the locks as required by CT-47a-21-a14 if that amount is disputed.

Based on approved deductions of $287.40 and accrued interest of $21.01, please send the remaining deposit and interest, totaling **$4,033.61**. CT-47a-21-d2 requires timely delivery of the deposit balance and accrued interest with an itemized statement and provides for potential double damages for a violation. I reserve my rights regarding that late statement and will seek advice from a Connecticut tenant-rights group or lawyer about the applicable remedy. Please also provide the written escrow notice identifying the amount held and the financial institution, as required by CT-47a-21-h4.

Please send the $4,033.61 and reply to this letter within 10 days. The exhibits referenced above are attached by Rentrail.

Sincerely,
[PERSON_1]
ruling.letter_ko_summary: 임대인에게 2027년 7월 31일 주소를 제공했고 8월 24일에 기한보다 3일 늦게 명세서를 받았다고 알립니다. 바닥 찍힘과 복도 벽 손상은 입주 때부터 있었음을 증거 E2/E12 및 E4/E14로 반박하고, 침실 벽 균열은 임차인 책임을 확인할 자료가 없다고 설명합니다. 인정 공제액 287.40달러와 이자 21.01달러를 반영한 환급액 4,033.61달러를 요청하고 10일 내 회신을 요구합니다. 지연 명세에 따른 추가 구제는 지역 임차인 지원단체나 변호사에게 확인하도록 하며, 에스크로 통지서도 요청합니다.
